development_constraints: This development bundle is contract-execution-ready but cannot satisfy a stable dependency.
Passing the bundle gate proves bundle integrity; it does not claim producer or host-driver conformance.
No compatibility promise begins before a signed stable release.
client_visible_changes: The workspace resource (schemas/resource.json) is closed, and 0.19.0 adds two required, read-only members to it: origin (created or adopted) and root_name. A client that validates workspace resources, events or listings against predecessor 0.18.0 rejects every workspace a 0.19.0 daemon reports, minted ones included, until it moves to 0.19.0 (ADR 0035).
Request shapes and workspace-id (ws_...) are unchanged; 0.19.0 adds one route, workspace.adopt at POST /v1/workspaces/adopt, beside the 36 routes it preserves from 0.18.0.
